in_hebrew.name: מִיקָלָא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The meaning of the name Miquela in Hebrew is 'Who is like God?'. This name is derived from the Hebrew root mqwl, meaning 'equal to' or 'like'. It is a powerful name that acknowledges the greatness and uniqueness of God.

in_greek.name: Μικαέλα
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Miquela in Greek is transliterated as Mikaela. It is derived from the Hebrew name Miquela and carries the same meaning: 'Who is like God?'. In Greek mythology, there is a goddess named Mikaela, but she is not related to the biblical name.

in_latin.name: Micaela
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Micaela is a direct transliteration of the Greek name Mikaela. It carries the same meaning as the Hebrew name: 'Who is like God?'. In medieval Europe, there was a popular legend about a young girl named Micaela who helped Saint James the Greater during his pilgrimage to Spain.
